BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.

5. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.

6. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.

7. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

8. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.

9. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

10. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.

11. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

12. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Site Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Information and Communication Technology

2. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A — CPU

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Site Preparation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Isometric Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
